Global (All).summary: COVID-19 continues to spread in some parts of the world, causing disruptions to travel and trade.
Political unrest in a country in North America has led to increased tensions and potential for violence.
A natural disaster has caused significant damage and loss of life in a region of the world.

United States.title: Tornadoes hit multiple states
United States.summary: At least 30 people were killed in the tornadoes that affected several states, including Alabama, Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kentucky, Mississippi, Missouri, Ohio, South Carolina and Tennessee.

United States.title: Supreme Court Justice Stephen Breyer to step down
United States.summary: Justice Stephen Breyer's retirement will create a vacancy on the Supreme Court, which President Biden has pledged to fill with a Black woman. This development is significant for the future of the Court and the US judicial system.

United States.title: FBI searches Trump's estate for classified documents
United States.summary: The FBI searched former President Trump's Mar-a-Lago estate as part of an investigation into the handling of classified documents. This development has sparked controversy and raised concerns about executive power and national security.

South Korea.summary: North Korea fired a ballistic missile off its east coast on Monday.
Rallies in South Korea to protest the military drills with the United States have turned violent, sparking concerns about social unrest.
South Korea has reported several cyberattacks targeting its government institutions and major companies, highlighting the country's growing concerns about cybersecurity threats.

Japan.title: Tokyo Olympic Stadium Vandalized
Japan.summary: The iconic Tokyo Olympic Stadium was vandalized with spray paint. The motive behind the vandalism is still unknown.

Japan.title: North Korea Fires Two Missiles Over Japan
Japan.summary: North Korea fired two ballistic missiles that flew over Japan, prompting an evacuation alert for the Japanese coast.

Japan.title: Japan's Fugitive Former Prime Minister Arrested
Japan.summary: Japan's fugitive former Prime Minister Abe Shinzo was arrested by the Metropolitan Police Department for alleged involvement in a cronyism scandal.
